title: Species richness of Eurasian Zephyrus hairstreaks (Lepidoptera: Lycaenidae: Theclini) with implications on historical biogeography: an NDM/VNDM approach
author: Hailing Zhuang

steps_raw.instruction: Step1: Construct the database with species distribution data and geographic information

Gathered literature published prior to 2016, and identified validity of species records including (geographical distribution record and taxonomic information of each species and then reviewed and compiled in Microsoft Excel 97-2003 sheet. Arrangement the data with the first line including ID, Species, Latitude, Longitude, Country, ADM and References.

Installed the software DIVA-GIS 7.5, NDM/VNDM 3 and Adobe Photoshop CS6 for Win7 system. Free vector and raster map data with WGS84 projection at 1:10m scale from public domain http://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/ for generating background world map and Whole world - land and oceans image that from Visible Earth https://visibleearth.nasa.gov/view.php?id=57752

Upload the species dataset to DIVA-GIS 7.5 and conduct format transformation, for example the file with .xls suffix transform to .shp, and then add the background map data layer to DIVA-GIS 7.5. Before analysis, species accumulation curve at genus level have been test using our database. This curve tends to go up and then it tends to slow down. It means relatively adequate sampling. Selecting the option Analysis-> point to grid-> richness, In the part of Parameters-> Field, we selected SPECIES, and In the part of Main, first, we need to define a new grid with 3° × 3° cell size, Output Variable selected Richness and “Number of different classes (Richness)” to count the different classes of a variable present in each cell size and give a list of conditioned equal interval values and scale and then export images according your request. Before export, we add the latitude-longitude grid to visual the location of our research.
According the code provided by VNDM/NDM Version 3 to recode the database to .xyd suffix which can be conduct in VNDM/NDM Version 3 (Goloboff, 2005).

We set the grid cell 2° and 3° for each species and genus level and original position (x=66.860, Y=59.883). Parameters were selected in accordance with Prado et al., (2015) with modification. Search was repeated 100 times, Our settings as follows: temporary sets within 0.99 of the current score, save sets with two or more endemic species, Scores above 2.0 were saved for genus-level analysis and above 3.0 for species-level analysis. Cells were swapped one cell at a time. Subsets were considered overlapping if 50% of the species were unique, and the search was repeated 100 times. A upper minimum score of 0.3 was selected (Escalante et al., 2013) and the consensus AOEs were computed using a cut-off of 50% similarity at different taxonomic levels and the flexible consensus was selected (Szumik et al., 2002).
Export the file format of DIVA-GIS from NDA of each generated AOEs and visual the distribution map of AOEs.
Generated each genus distribution map using DIVA-GIS, after classifying different distribution, then integrate similar distribution pattern species database to reconstruct distribution pattern.
